score_reasoning.value_comm: Shows '81% off' prominently in title but fails to show original price anywhere on page. Customer has zero context to verify the savings claim or understand what they're saving from. This is a critical failure in value communication.
score_reasoning.completeness: Missing most category-critical information for online education: course duration, access period, instructor credentials, detailed curriculum, learning format, prerequisites, and certification accreditation. Cautious buyers would have many unanswered questions before purchasing.
